name: Siwek Lumber & Millwork Corp - NE MPLS
old_description: We know doors better than anyone and are your complete headquarters for all your exterior door needs!
about:
Siwek Lumber & Millwork Corp has operated from its Northeast Minneapolis location at 2536 Marshall Street since 1933. The family-owned lumberyard was established as a neighborhood supplier of building materials and has remained under family stewardship for nine decades.

The company stocks a full line of construction lumber, redwood, and cedar for decking, fencing, and garden beds, and serves as a complete headquarters for exterior doors including Andersen storm doors. It also carries Milwaukee power tools, GRK fasteners, and related accessories from a single 2536 Marshall St NE facility. Headcount and facility square footage are not publicly disclosed.

Customers include residential contractors, remodelers, and homeowners throughout the Twin Cities metro. The yard supplies materials for projects ranging from new construction to backyard decks, and has supported community builds such as Boy Scout Troop 9060 in Woodbury, which used donated lumber for campfire benches.

Siwek emphasizes its local roots and environmental stewardship. In 2019 the company received a Hennepin County Business Recycling Grant and reports that 75.25 percent of its scrap building materials — 153.55 tons — have been diverted from landfill, with aggregate, alternative daily cover, metals, and mixed woods among the recycled streams.
